comment: Moonlight game streaming (Sunshine, Apollo or Wolf). host: the gaming PC's name or IP, filled in by `moonlight.py pair` (saved in ~/.config/tv-project/moonlight.json); empty = the Moonlight tile just opens Moonlight. tileApp: the host app the Moonlight tile streams (Sunshine: Desktop; Wolf: Wolf UI). options are passed to `moonlight stream`. bootSeconds: per app, how long the loading screen stays after a fresh start. keepRunningMinutes: after Home the app keeps running on the host this long, then it is quit; -1 = never (e.g. a server-side watchdog such as scripts/server/wolf-idle-watchdog.sh decides). Change any of it in ~/.config/tv-project/moonlight.json.
